idea-plugin.name: Godot Extended Launch
idea-plugin.description:
Runs a Godot 4 scene and shows it inside an IDE tool window, with mouse and keyboard forwarded to the game. Works in Rider, IntelliJ IDEA and every other IntelliJ-based IDE.
  • "Godot Scene" run configuration: scene, project dir, rendering driver, optional launcher script.
  • Right-click any .tscn → Run.
  • Godot renders normally (Vulkan/Metal, compute shaders included); frames stream to the IDE.
